lA NO: 1 OF 2025  Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstanc stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased pleased to direct the official respondents not to accept the surrender of land to in extent of Ac.0.84 cents in Sy.No. 118/1, an extent of Ac.0.50 cents in Sy.No. 117/1, an extent of Ac.0.75 cents in Sy.No. 177/1 and an extent of Ac.0.30 cents in Sy.No.117/2 of Z.Chinthuva Revenue Village, Rambilli Mandal, Anakapalli District and not to pay any compensation to the un official respondents without considering the representation/legal notice   04.11.2016, Pending disposal of WP 24953 of 2025, on the file of the High Court.

The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the affidavit filed in support thereof and the order of the High Court dated 16.09.2025 made herein and upon hearing the arguments of Sri. Mangena Sree Rama Rao Advocate for the Petitioner, GP for Land Acquisition,
Advocate for the Respondents, the Court made the following:
ORDER:
"At request of learned counsel for the petitioner for filing proof of service, post the matter after four (04) weeks.
In the meantime, official respondents are also directed to file their counters.

Interim order granted earlier, is extended for a further period of eight (08) weeks.
